claims.claim: Container drums / water storage drums / plastic barrel / plastic drum and kegs
claims.evidence: Witness observed multiple blue plastic barrels/containers stacked outdoors with lids/cover tops; no other container type was reported.
Witness report describes plastic barrels/containers only; no steel drums were observed.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume is unknown, which strongly affects value.
risks.proof: A photo showing the barrel’s litre marking or a tape-measure shot with a clear capacity label (e.g., 20L/25L/50L/100L) on the side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used plastic water storage barrels with unknown capacity (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Food-grade vs chemical-grade is unknown (safety/compliance risk).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of any certification/grade marking (food-grade/NSF/BPA-free) or the manufacturer label on the barrel.

risks.risk: Condition is uncertain: cracks, dents, warping, UV degradation, and lid tightness could reduce usability and resale.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of each barrel’s body and lid area (including underside and around the lid rim) plus a quick lid-seal check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential wear and uncertain lid sealing.

risks.risk: Leak risk: lids may be loose/partially placed; no leak test evidence.
risks.proof: A short video of filling one barrel with water and showing no drips/leaks over a few minutes, or a simple pour test clip.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven leak-free (worst-case: treat as needing testing/possible leakage).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/fittings (tap/spigot, bung, seals) could make the barrels less useful.
risks.proof: Photos showing whether any tap/spigot/bung/seal is installed, and if included, a close-up of the fitting and its condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as barrels only, with accessories not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer and model are not readable; could indicate lower/higher quality or different intended use.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any embossed/printed brand/model text on the barrel (side/bottom) or the label area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unbranded generic plastic barrels.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any litre/capacity marking on the barrel (or a photo with a measuring tape and the exact dimensions).
Show whether the barrels are food-grade/chemical-grade via any visible certification or grade marking on the barrel.
Provide close-up photos/videos of cracks/dents/warping and the lid rim for each barrel.
Do a quick leak test video: fill one barrel with water and show it for a few minutes with no drips.
Confirm whether taps/spigots/bungs/seals are included; send close-ups of any fittings.
response.reason: The witness can confirm the item type (blue plastic water storage barrels), but key pricing drivers—capacity, grade, condition, and leak-free status—are not verifiable from the report. Proof is needed to avoid overpaying for worst-case barrels.
